mapper.select: SELECT s.spot_name, s.x_coord, s.y_coord, s.consistency_score, s.complexity_level, s.ground_truth, MAX(CASE WHEN m.name = 'CCST' THEN sml.label END) as CCST, MAX(CASE WHEN m.name = 'conST' THEN sml.label END) as conST, MAX(CASE WHEN m.name = 'DeepST' THEN sml.label END) as DeepST, MAX(CASE WHEN m.name = 'GraphST' THEN sml.label END) as GraphST, MAX(CASE WHEN m.name = 'spaceflow' THEN sml.label END) as spaceflow, MAX(CASE WHEN m.name = 'SpaGCN' THEN sml.label END) as SpaGCN, MAX(CASE WHEN m.name = 'STAGATE' THEN sml.label END) as STAGATE, MAX(CASE WHEN m.name = 'STAIG' THEN sml.label END) as STAIG FROM spot s LEFT JOIN spot_method_label sml ON s.id = sml.spot_id LEFT JOIN method m ON sml.method_id = m.id WHERE s.dataset_id = #{datasetId} GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.id
